parts.text: When did I officially move to Portland?
You officially moved to Portland on May 31, 2024.
Who is the 'intimidating' professor mentioned in August 2024?
Professor Chen is the intimidating professor mentioned in August 2024.
What specific car repair was needed in November 2024 and how much did it cost?
Your car needed a new starter and battery in November 2024, and the estimate was $500.
What is the name of the coffee shop I found in July?
The coffee shop is called 'The Grind'.
How many days did I participate in the 'Inktober' challenge in October 2024?
You participated in the 'Inktober' challenge for all 31 days of October 2024.
